# Sector Views: Monthly Stock Sector Outlook

Schwab Sector Views is our six- to 12-month outlook for stock sectors, which represent broad sectors of the economy. The Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR) combines a factor-based approach with a market and economic assessment to determine the ratings. Communication Services, more favored. Consumer Discretionary, least favored. Consumer Staples, Energy and Financials, all neutral. Health Care, more favored. Industrials, more favored. Information Technology, neutral. Materials, more favored. Real Estate, least favored. Utilities, less favored.

Source: Schwab Center for Financial Research, as of 6/26/2026.
